title: BBC Learning English from the News 2024 — Quiz 9
description: Choose the best answer for each question about vocabulary and usage.

elements.name: q81_mixed_feelings
elements.title: Sam has mixed feelings about moving. What does this mean?
choices: Sam feels both positive and negative about it.
Sam has no opinion about it.
Sam has one clear reason for opposing it.
Sam is pleased about every part of it.
elements.correctAnswer: Sam feels both positive and negative about it.

elements.name: q82_makes_gains
elements.title: The new party makes gains in local elections. What does that mean?
choices: It gives up the seats it already holds.
It improves its position by winning more support or seats.
Its results are exactly the same as before.
It withdraws all of its candidates.
elements.correctAnswer: It improves its position by winning more support or seats.

elements.name: q83_slumps
elements.title: The price slumps after the announcement. What happens to the price?
choices: It changes by an imperceptible amount.

elements.name: q84_surges
elements.title: Demand surges when tickets go on sale. What happens to demand?
choices: It stays at its earlier level.

elements.name: q85_stroll
elements.title: Which preposition completes this sentence? “After lunch, we went ___ a stroll around the lake.”

elements.name: q86_mull_something_over
elements.title: Which sentence correctly places the pronoun “it” in the phrase “mull over”?

elements.name: q87_neck_and_neck
elements.title: Which preposition completes this sentence? “The two cyclists were neck and neck ___ each other as they approached the finish line.”

elements.name: q88_braces_for
elements.title: Which preposition completes this sentence? “The residents are bracing ___ another night of heavy rain.”

elements.name: q89_drop_out
elements.title: Which phrase completes this sentence? “I signed up for a pottery course, but I had to ___ after the first class, so I cancelled my enrolment.”

elements.name: q90_leapfrog
elements.title: Which word correctly completes this sentence? “Over the past two months, the team has ___ three rivals in the rankings.”
